pre_result_plan.baseline: The observed Session 057 task had 1 failed manifest invocation before the valid manifest.

result.reason: Two argparse aliases absorb the exact Session 057 naming mistake while preserving one implementation path and canonical output; no wrapper, pre-read mandate or fallback parser is justified.
limitations: The intervention is a replay of the real Session 057 command after implementation, not a prospective field use.
